description:
Relieve Therapeutics is a wellness brand focused on supporting people living with chronic pain, nerve discomfort, and inflammation.

Our flagship product is a premium PEA (Palmitoylethanolamide) supplement, a naturally occurring compound studied for its role in supporting the body’s response to inflammation and nerve irritation.

Our mission is to help people living with chronic pain regain comfort, mobility, and quality of life through science-backed nutritional support.

What Makes Us Different

• Advanced PEA formula designed for optimal absorption
• Developed with a focus on nerve pain and inflammation support
• Premium quality ingredients with strict manufacturing standards
• A brand built specifically for the chronic pain community
• Educational approach — we focus on explaining the science behind pain and inflammation

Our goal is not just to sell supplements but to educate and support people living with persistent pain conditions.

How Affiliates Can Earn

Creators partnering with Relieve Therapeutics can earn through:

• Affiliate commissions on sales generated through their link or code
• Paid UGC opportunities for high-performing content
• Performance bonuses for top-converting creators
• Potential for long-term partnerships with recurring campaigns

We are looking to build relationships with creators who genuinely connect with our mission and audience.

How to Promote Us

We encourage authentic content that resonates with your audience. Popular formats include:

• Your daily wellness or supplement routine
• Educational content about chronic pain or inflammation
• Product experience or testimonial videos
• “What helps my chronic pain” style content
• Lifestyle content showing how you manage pain or recovery

Short-form video formats such as TikTok and Instagram Reels perform especially well.

Other Information

We are particularly interested in collaborating with creators in niches such as:

• chronic pain
• fibromyalgia
• nerve pain / neuropathy
• arthritis
• autoimmune conditions
• wellness and inflammation support
• biohacking and longevity

Creators will receive product samples, affiliate support, and creative guidance, while still maintaining full creative freedom so content feels natural and authentic.

Our goal is to build a community of creators who help raise awareness about new approaches to supporting chronic pain naturally.
